events.title: JUDGMENT HOUR
events.summary: WHAT IS JUDGMENT HOUR?It's a global event system and we decide when the event happens. Through our actions we influence how close we are to reaching it. We can see in the main menu at all times how close we are. It can be affected by many player actions and behaviors in-game. We can get closer, or further, depending on how we play. events.summary: I'm happy to announce that we're officially entering BETA PHASE. From now on, we will be regularly testing the game with the community, with the goal of improving it and making sure that it's as balanced as it can be and the technical quality is up to a high standard.
